products.title: My products
products.description: Your accounts, wallets and cards, grouped by institution.
products.empty: You haven't added any product yet
products.unconfigured: Set up this card: without a limit its balance doesn't say what you owe and it doesn't count in your net worth.
products.deleteHasProducts: To delete it, first move or unlink its products
products.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. No product is touched (it has none).

anchor.cardIntro: Copy the statement date and the full payment from your statement. The card gets that debt and only what you record after the statement adds to it.
anchor.bankIntro: Copy the balance your bank shows and the day it's for. The account gets that balance and only what you record after that day adds to it.
anchor.totalDebtHint: Use the full payment, not the minimum: paying it leaves the card at 0.
anchor.balanceHint: The balance at the end of that day. It can be negative (overdraft).
anchor.explainCard: {{name}}'s balance becomes {{amount}}: you owed {{debt}} at the {{date}} statement.
anchor.explainBank: {{name}}'s balance becomes {{amount}}, the bank's at the end of {{date}}.
anchor.explainFrom: From {{from}} only movements you record on that date or later add up. Anything on {{date}} or before is already inside that balance and isn't counted twice.
anchor.explainHistory: Your movements aren't deleted or moved: they stay as spending or income in their periods and budgets.
anchor.explainLimit: The limit becomes {{limit}}: the card starts counting as debt in your net worth.
anchor.explainUndo: It's kept in the adjustment history and you can undo it.
anchor.afterHint: The final balance is that plus what you recorded since {{from}}. After confirming you'll see the balance before and after as Cashifa computes it.
anchor.saveValidationError: The server didn't accept the adjustment: check that the date isn't in the future and the amounts.
anchor.saveError: The adjustment couldn't be saved. Try again.
anchor.revertConflict: It can't be undone: it was already undone or there's a newer adjustment. Undo the newest first.
anchor.revertError: It couldn't be undone. Try again.

accounts.limitNeedsStatement: This card already has a balance: its limit is set with “Match statement”, together with what you owed at the cut.
accounts.paymentDayHint: Payment falls in the month after the cut. The rate only estimates interest; the real one is on the statement.
accounts.lastStatementHint: If you already use it, enter your last statement: the card starts with that debt and nothing before the cut is counted twice.
accounts.initialBalanceHint: Today's balance. It can be negative (overdraft).
accounts.typeChangeHint: An account with movements can't become a credit card or stop being one: its balance would change meaning.
accounts.legacyDebitCard: This account has the old “Debit card” type. Saving turns it into a savings account with a debit card (or pick checking). Its balance doesn't change.
accounts.institutionExists: An institution with that name already exists. Pick it from the list.
accounts.saveValidationError: The server didn't accept the data. Check the type (an account with movements can't become a card or stop being one) and the card fields.
accounts.statementError: The card was created, but it couldn't be matched to its statement. Do it from My products with “Match statement”.
